title: How to Build a Stripe Subscription App (Without Writing Backend Code)
summary: Build a Stripe-powered subscription SaaS without backend wiring. Full guide: auth, database, webhooks, billing portal — all included with Blink.
body_markdown:
Your project runs on your live Stripe connection, so test the real flow at zero cost: ask Blink to create a **100% off forever promo code** , then walk through every scenario with your own card — the charge is zero:


1. Sign up → choose a plan → Stripe Checkout with the promo code → trial starts → verify access
2. Customer Portal → upgrade/downgrade → verify tier changes
3. Customer Portal → cancel → verify access continues to the period end, then locks


Everything you're testing — the database writes, subscription status checks, portal redirects — Blink generated from your prompt.
